message.content: Maybe the deck went up unchanged because nobody below Skilling dared to touch it. I am not sure that is what the messages show, though.
Perhaps we could keep the chapter ambiguous about whether he read it at all. That would let the Friday messages carry the turn.

I have gone back and forth on this all morning. Let's keep it ambiguous whether Skilling read the deck until the Friday thread. The reader should sit with the unchanged deck first, and the Friday messages can carry the turn.
Understood. I will treat that as the shape of the chapter and not resolve it earlier.
